items.headline: Radek Vitek transfer to Middlesbrough agreed
items.summary: Manchester United have agreed to sell goalkeeper Radek Vitek to Middlesbrough as part of goalkeeping squad adjustments.

items.headline: Benjamin Sesko recovery progressing well
items.summary: Benjamin Sesko is progressing in his recovery from injury and is described as 'getting there' by club sources.

items.headline: Diogo Dalot returns to squad for PSG pre-season match
items.summary: Diogo Dalot returns for Manchester United's pre-season fixture against PSG after injury absence.

items.headline: Marcus Rashford set to return to Carrington
items.summary: Marcus Rashford expected to return to Carrington training facility from Monday with motivation to prove himself immediately.

items.headline: Toby Collyer told he can leave permanently
items.summary: Manchester United midfielder Toby Collyer has been told he can leave the club permanently after two unsuccessful Championship loan spells.
